### Module 04 — Machine Learning for Clinical Prediction

# Capstone · End-to-End Clinical ML Pipeline

***
**This capstone integrates NB-01 through NB-07 into a single production-ready ML pipeline.**

**Pipeline stages:**
1. Data assembly, EDA, and train/val/test temporal splits
2. Preprocessing pipeline with leakage-safe transforms
3. Baseline and candidate model comparison (LR, RF, GBM, XGBoost)
4. Hyperparameter optimisation with `tune_bayes` (best model)
5. Comprehensive evaluation: AUC, AP, calibration, DCA, EPV
6. SHAP-style global and local explanations (`DALEX` / `fastshap`)
7. Risk stratification and patient dashboard
8. MLOps-ready: model serialisation + drift detection template
9. Publication-quality summary figure + methods narrative

**Estimated time:** 4 hours | **Level:** Advanced

## 0. Setup & Data


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(ranger)
library(xgboost)
library(DALEX)
library(fastshap)
library(vip)
library(jsonlite)
library(digest)
library(patchwork)
tidymodels_prefer()
set.seed(42)

mod04_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod04")
dir.create(mod04_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)
col_blue <- "#2563EB"; col_red <- "#DC2626"; col_green <- "#16A34A"
col_gold <- "#D97706"; col_navy <- "#1E3A8A"
SEED <- 42
auc_prob   <- function(y, p) yardstick::roc_auc_vec(factor(y, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second")
ap_prob    <- function(y, p) yardstick::pr_auc_vec(factor(y, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second")
brier_prob <- function(y, p) mean((p - y)^2)
sig <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
clip <- function(x, lo, hi) pmin(pmax(x, lo), hi)

# ── Build dataset ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(SEED); N <- 3500
b <- matrix(rnorm(N * 4), ncol = 4); set.seed(99)
age <- as.integer(clip(rnorm(N, 62, 15), 18, 92))
sex <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
payer <- sample(c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay", "Other"),
                N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.07, 0.03))
admit_type <- sample(c("Emergency", "Elective", "Urgent"),
                     N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.18))
los_days <- as.integer(clip(round(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8)), 1, 30))
diabetes <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.6 * b[, 1] - 0.5 + 0.02 * (age - 62) / 15))
hypertension <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.7 * b[, 1] - 0.2))
hf <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.4 * b[, 2] + 0.5 * hypertension - 1.5))
copd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 3] - 1.0))
ckd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] + 0.6 * diabetes - 1.2))
obesity <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] - 0.8))
depression <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.3 * b[, 4] - 1.4))
n_comorb <- diabetes + hypertension + hf + copd + ckd
set.seed(21)
glucose <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 105 + 15 * diabetes, 28), 50, 400), 1)
creatinine <- round(clip(rgamma(N, shape = 1.6 + 0.8 * hf, scale = 0.6), 0.4, 10), 2)
hba1c <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 6.5 + 0.8 * diabetes, 1.4), 4, 14), 1)
sbp <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 128 + 12 * hypertension, 18), 80, 200), 0)
bmi <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 28 + 4 * obesity, 6), 15, 55), 1)
logit <- (-3.2 + 0.6 * hf + 0.5 * diabetes + 0.5 * ckd + 0.3 * copd +
            0.02 * (age - 62) / 15 +
            0.3 * as.integer(admit_type == "Emergency") +
            0.25 * as.integer(payer == "Medicaid") +
            0.2 * as.integer(los_days > 7) +
            0.5 * hf * diabetes + rnorm(N, 0, 0.25))
readmitted <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(logit))
start <- as.Date("2019-01-01"); set.seed(5)
admit_dates <- start + sample.int(as.integer(as.Date("2023-12-31") - start), N, replace = TRUE)
df <- tibble(
  patient_id = sprintf("PT-%05d", seq_len(N)),
  age, sex, payer, admit_type, los_days,
  diabetes, hypertension, hf, copd, ckd, obesity, depression, n_comorb,
  glucose, creatinine, hba1c, sbp, bmi,
  readmitted, admit_date = admit_dates
) %>% arrange(admit_date)
df$los_gt7 <- as.integer(df$los_days > 7)
NUMERIC <- c("age", "los_days", "n_comorb", "glucose", "creatinine", "hba1c", "sbp", "bmi")
BINARY <- c("diabetes", "hypertension", "hf", "copd", "ckd", "obesity", "depression", "los_gt7")
CATEGORIC <- c("sex", "payer", "admit_type")
FEATURES <- c(NUMERIC, BINARY, CATEGORIC); TARGET <- "readmitted"
cat(sprintf("Dataset: %d x %d | Positive rate: %.1f%%\n",
            nrow(df), ncol(df), mean(df[[TARGET]]) * 100))
```

## 1. Temporal Train / Val / Test Split

```{.r .cell-code}
df_train <- df %>% filter(admit_year <= 2021)
df_val   <- df %>% filter(admit_year == 2022)
df_test  <- df %>% filter(admit_year == 2023)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
to_ml <- function(d) {
  d %>% select(all_of(c(FEATURES, TARGET))) %>%
    mutate(readmitted = factor(readmitted, levels = c(0, 1)))
}
X_train <- to_ml(df_train); y_train <- df_train[[TARGET]]
X_val   <- to_ml(df_val);   y_val   <- df_val[[TARGET]]
X_test  <- to_ml(df_test);  y_test  <- df_test[[TARGET]]
```

## 2. Preprocessing Pipeline (Leakage-Safe)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
rec <- recipe(readmitted ~ ., data = X_train) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_of(NUMERIC)) %>%
  step_normalize(all_of(NUMERIC)) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_of(BINARY)) %>%
  step_impute_mode(all_of(CATEGORIC)) %>%
  step_dummy(all_of(CATEGORIC), one_hot = TRUE)
pre <- prep(rec, training = X_train)  # FIT ONLY ON TRAIN
bake_x <- function(d) bake(pre, new_data = d) %>% select(-readmitted)
Xtr_df  <- bake_x(X_train)
Xval_df <- bake_x(X_val)
Xte_df  <- bake_x(X_test)
Xtr <- as.matrix(Xtr_df); Xval <- as.matrix(Xval_df); Xte <- as.matrix(Xte_df)
feat_nm <- colnames(Xtr)
cat(sprintf("Features: %d | Train:%s Val:%s Test:%s\n",
            length(feat_nm),
            paste(dim(Xtr), collapse = " x "),
            paste(dim(Xval), collapse = " x "),
            paste(dim(Xte), collapse = " x ")))
```

```{.r .cell-code}
pred_pack <- function(p_val, p_test, name) {
```

## 4. Bayesian Fine-Tuning of Best Model


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(SEED)
# tune_bayes on boost_tree (xgboost engine) — analogue of Optuna TPE
xgb_spec <- boost_tree(
  trees = tune(), tree_depth = tune(), learn_rate = tune(),
  sample_size = tune(), min_n = tune()
) %>% set_engine("xgboost") %>% set_mode("classification")

tune_data <- Xtr_df %>% mutate(readmitted = factor(y_train, levels = c(0, 1)))
xgb_wf <- workflow() %>% add_model(xgb_spec) %>% add_formula(readmitted ~ .)
skf <- vfold_cv(tune_data, v = 3, strata = readmitted)

xgb_param <- extract_parameter_set_dials(xgb_wf) %>%
  update(
    trees      = trees(range = c(100L, 400L)),
    tree_depth = tree_depth(range = c(3L, 8L)),
    learn_rate = learn_rate(range = c(-2, log10(0.3))),
    sample_size = sample_prop(range = c(0.5, 1.0)),
    min_n      = min_n(range = c(5L, 30L))
  )

study <- tune_bayes(
  xgb_wf, resamples = skf, param_info = xgb_param,
  initial = 8, iter = 20,
  metrics = metric_set(roc_auc),
  control = control_bayes(no_improve = 8, verbose = FALSE)
)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
best_t <- select_best(study, metric = "roc_auc")
final_wf <- finalize_workflow(xgb_wf, best_t) %>% fit(tune_data)
p_opt_val  <- predict(final_wf, new_data = Xval_df, type = "prob")$.pred_1
p_opt_test <- predict(final_wf, new_data = Xte_df,  type = "prob")$.pred_1
final_model <- extract_fit_engine(final_wf)

cat(sprintf("tune_bayes best CV AUC : %.4f\n", show_best(study, metric = "roc_auc", n = 1)$mean))
```

## 5. Calibration with Platt Scaling


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
platt <- glm(y ~ p, data = tibble(y = y_val, p = p_opt_val), family = binomial)
p_cal <- as.numeric(predict(platt, newdata = tibble(p = p_opt_test), type = "response"))

brier_raw <- brier_prob(y_test, p_opt_test)
brier_cal <- brier_prob(y_test, p_cal)
auc_final <- auc_prob(y_test, p_cal)
cat(sprintf("Final model (calibrated): AUC=%.4f | Brier: %.4f→%.4f\n",
            auc_final, brier_raw, brier_cal))
```

## 6. SHAP Global Explanations


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pred_fun <- function(object, newdata) {
  predict(object, as.matrix(newdata))
}
set.seed(SEED)
shap_vals <- tryCatch({
  fastshap::explain(
    final_model, X = as.data.frame(Xtr_df),
    newdata = as.data.frame(Xte_df),
    pred_wrapper = pred_fun, nsim = 20, adjust = TRUE
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("SHAP:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
  NULL
})
if (!is.null(shap_vals)) {
  shap_mat <- as.matrix(shap_vals)
  mean_abs_shap <- colMeans(abs(shap_mat))
  top15 <- order(mean_abs_shap, decreasing = TRUE)[1:15]
  cat("Top 5 features by mean |SHAP|:\n")
  for (i in top15[1:5]) {
    cat(sprintf("  %-20s: %.4f\n", feat_nm[i], mean_abs_shap[i]))
  }
  shap_ok <- TRUE
} else {
  shap_ok <- FALSE
  shap_mat <- NULL
  mean_abs_shap <- NULL
}
```

## 7. Risk Stratification & Patient Dashboard


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
risk_tier <- function(prob) {
  case_when(
    prob < 0.10 ~ "Low (<10%)",
    prob < 0.20 ~ "Moderate (10-20%)",
    prob < 0.35 ~ "High (20-35%)",
    TRUE        ~ "Very high (>35%)"
  )
}

df_results <- df_test %>%
  select(patient_id, age, sex, payer, hf, diabetes, ckd, los_days) %>%
  mutate(
    pred_prob = round(p_cal, 4),
    risk_tier = risk_tier(pred_prob),
    y_true    = y_test
  )

tier_stats <- df_results %>%
  group_by(risk_tier) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    actual_rate = mean(y_true) * 100,
    mean_prob   = mean(pred_prob) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(actual_rate, mean_prob), ~ round(.x, 1)))
cat("Risk tier summary:\n")
```

## 8. Publication Summary Figure


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# A — Data split timeline
monthly <- df %>%
  mutate(month = as.Date(cut(admit_date, "month"))) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(rate = mean(.data[[TARGET]]) * 100, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(split_lab = case_when(
    as.integer(format(month, "%Y")) <= 2021 ~ "Train≤2021",
    as.integer(format(month, "%Y")) == 2022 ~ "Val 2022",
    TRUE ~ "Test 2023"
  ))
p_a <- ggplot(monthly, aes(month, rate, fill = split_lab)) +
  geom_col(width = 20, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Train≤2021" = col_blue, "Val 2022" = col_green, "Test 2023" = col_red)) +
  labs(y = "Readmission rate (%)", x = NULL, fill = NULL, title = "A  Temporal split") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")

# B — Model race
race_long <- race_df %>%
  select(Model, `Val AUC`, `Test AUC`) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Model, names_to = "split", values_to = "auc")
p_b <- ggplot(race_long, aes(Model, auc, fill = split)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.65, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", auc)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), vjust = -0.3, size = 2.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Val AUC" = col_blue, "Test AUC" = col_red)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5, 0.85)) +
  labs(y = "AUC-ROC", x = NULL, fill = NULL, title = "B  Model race") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 12, hjust = 1))

# C — ROC
roc_f <- yardstick::roc_curve(
  tibble(truth = factor(y_test, levels = c(0, 1)), .pred = p_cal),
  truth, .pred, event_level = "second"
)
p_c <- ggplot(roc_f, aes(1 - specificity, sensitivity)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = sensitivity), fill = col_navy, alpha = 0.10) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_path(colour = col_navy, linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "1-Specificity", y = "Sensitivity",
       title = sprintf("C  ROC (AUC=%.3f)", auc_final))

# D — Calibration
cal <- tibble(y = y_test, p = p_cal) %>%
  mutate(bin = ntile(p, 10)) %>%
  group_by(bin) %>%
  summarise(mean_pred = mean(p), frac_pos = mean(y), .groups = "drop")
p_d <- ggplot(cal, aes(mean_pred, frac_pos)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(colour = col_red, size = 2) + geom_line(colour = col_red) +
  labs(x = "Predicted", y = "Observed fraction",
       title = sprintf("D  Calibration (Brier=%.3f)", brier_cal))

# E — Risk tier
tier_order <- c("Low (<10%)", "Moderate (10-20%)", "High (20-35%)", "Very high (>35%)")
tier_plot <- tibble(tier = tier_order) %>%
  left_join(tier_stats, by = c("tier" = "risk_tier")) %>%
  mutate(actual_rate = replace_na(actual_rate, 0), N = replace_na(N, 0),
         tier_short = c("Low", "Mod", "High", "V.High"))
p_e <- ggplot(tier_plot, aes(tier_short, actual_rate, fill = tier_short)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%% (n=%d)", actual_rate, N)), vjust = -0.3, size = 2.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Low" = col_blue, "Mod" = col_green, "High" = col_gold, "V.High" = col_red)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Actual readmission rate (%)", title = "E  Risk stratification")

# F — DCA
net_benefit <- function(yt, yp, t) {
  yp_b <- as.integer(yp >= t)
  tp <- sum(yp_b == 1 & yt == 1); fp <- sum(yp_b == 1 & yt == 0)
  (tp - fp * (t / (1 - t))) / length(yt)
}
thrs_dca <- seq(0.01, 0.50, length.out = 80)
dca <- tibble(
  t = thrs_dca,
  model = map_dbl(thrs_dca, ~ net_benefit(y_test, p_cal, .x)),
  all   = map_dbl(thrs_dca, ~ net_benefit(y_test, rep(1, length(y_test)), .x))
)
p_f <- ggplot(dca, aes(t)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = model, colour = "Model"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = all,   colour = "Treat all"), linetype = "dotdash") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Model" = col_navy, "Treat all" = "grey20")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "Threshold", y = "Net benefit", colour = NULL, title = "F  Decision Curve Analysis")

# G — SHAP bar
if (isTRUE(shap_ok)) {
  top_idx2 <- order(mean_abs_shap)[(length(mean_abs_shap) - 11):length(mean_abs_shap)]
  shap_bar <- tibble(feat = feat_nm[top_idx2], imp = mean_abs_shap[top_idx2])
  p_g <- ggplot(shap_bar, aes(imp, reorder(feat, imp))) +
    geom_col(fill = col_blue, alpha = 0.85) +
    labs(x = "Mean |SHAP value|", y = NULL, title = "G  SHAP feature importance")
} else {
  vi_g <- vip::vi(final_model)
  p_g <- ggplot(vi_g %>% slice_max(Importance, n = 12),
                aes(Importance, reorder(Variable, Importance))) +
    geom_col(fill = col_blue, alpha = 0.85) +
    labs(x = "Gini importance", y = NULL, title = "G  Feature importance (MDI)")
}

# H — Score distribution
p_h <- tibble(p = p_cal, y = factor(y_test, labels = c("Not readmitted", "Readmitted"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(p, fill = y)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 30, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.20, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Not readmitted" = col_blue, "Readmitted" = col_red)) +
  labs(x = "Predicted readmission probability", y = "Density", fill = NULL,
       title = "H  Score distribution by outcome")

design <- "
AABB
CDEF
GGHH
"
p_a + p_b + p_c + p_d + p_e + p_f + p_g + p_h +
  plot_layout(design = design) +
  plot_annotation(title = "End-to-End Clinical ML Pipeline — 30-Day Readmission (N=3,500)")
```

```{.r .cell-code}
# Drift detection: compare feature means between train and test
drift_df <- map_dfr(NUMERIC, function(col) {
  mean_tr <- mean(df_train[[col]]); mean_te <- mean(df_test[[col]])
  pct_drift <- abs(mean_te - mean_tr) / max(abs(mean_tr), 1e-8) * 100
  tibble(
    Feature = col, `Train mean` = round(mean_tr, 2), `Test mean` = round(mean_te, 2),
    `Drift %` = round(pct_drift, 1),
    Flag = if_else(pct_drift > 10, ">10%❗", "OK")
  )
})
cat(" Feature drift report (train→test):\n")
```

## 10. Methods Narrative (Template)

> **Machine Learning Methods**
>
> We split the data temporally: training (2019–2021, N=XXX), validation (2022, N=XXX), and test (2023, N=XXX) to simulate prospective deployment. All preprocessing (median imputation, standardisation, one-hot encoding) was fit exclusively on training data to prevent leakage.
>
> We evaluated four candidate models: logistic regression (L2), random forest, gradient boosting (GBM), and XGBoost. The GBM was selected based on validation AUC and further tuned with 20-iteration Bayesian optimisation (`tune::tune_bayes`). Predicted probabilities were recalibrated on the validation set using Platt scaling; calibration was assessed visually and via Brier score.
>
> Discrimination was quantified by AUC-ROC and Average Precision (AUC-PR), both with 1000-sample bootstrap 95% CIs. Clinical utility was assessed by Decision Curve Analysis at thresholds 1–50%. Model explanations were generated with `fastshap` and `DALEX`; global importance was summarised by mean |SHAP value| and local explanations were produced for high-risk patients.
>
> The final model was serialised and a feature drift template implemented to monitor input distribution shifts in production. EPV = XX (events per variable), confirming adequate sample size for the XX-feature model.
>
> All analyses used R 4.3+ (tidymodels, ranger, xgboost, lightgbm, DALEX, fastshap).
